devdoc.details: Pool Factory manages Illuvium staking pools, provides a single      public interface to access the pools, provides an interface for the pools      to mint yield rewards, access pool-related info, update weights, etc.The factory is authorized (via its owner) to register new pools, change weights      of the existing pools, removing the pools (by changing their weights to zero).The factory requires ROLE_TOKEN_CREATOR permission on the ILV and sILV tokens to mint yield      (see `mintYieldTo` function).

params.fnSelector: function selector, defines a function where error was thrown

changePoolWeight(address,uint32).details: Changes the weight of the pool;      executed by the pool itself or by the factory owner.

params.pool: address of the pool to change weight for
params.weight: new weight value to set to

params.poolToken: pool token address (like ILV) to query pool address for

returns._0: pool address for the token specified

params._poolToken: pool token address to query pool information for.

returns._0: pool information packed in a PoolData struct.

params._endTime: timestamp number when farming stops and rewards cannot be updated anymore
params._secondsPerUpdate: how frequently the rewards gets updated (decreased by 3%), seconds

mintYieldTo(address,uint256,bool).details: Mints ILV tokens; executed by ILV Pool only.Requires factory to have ROLE_TOKEN_CREATOR permission      on the ILV ERC20 token instance.

params._to: an address to mint tokens to
params._useSILV: whether ILV or sILV should be minted
params._value: amount of ILV tokens to mint

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

registerPool(address).details: Registers an already deployed pool instance within the factory.Can be executed by the pool factory owner only.

params.pool: address of the already deployed pool instance

renounceOwnership().details: Overrides `Ownable.renounceOwnership()`, to avoid accidentally      renouncing ownership of the PoolFactory contract.

params._endTime: new end time value to be stored

shouldUpdateRatio().details: Verifies if `secondsPerUpdate` has passed since last ILV/second      ratio update and if ILV/second reward can be decreased by 3%.

returns._0: true if enough time has passed and `updateILVPerSecond` can be executed.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

__gap.details: Empty reserved space in storage. The size of the __gap array is calculated so that      the amount of storage used by a contract always adds up to the 50.      See https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/4.x/upgradeable#storage_gaps

endTime.details: End time is the last timestamp when ILV/second can be decreased;      it is implied that yield farming stops after that timestamp.

ilvPerSecond.details: ILV/second determines yield farming reward base      used by the yield pools controlled by the factory.

lastRatioUpdate.details: Each time the ILV/second ratio gets updated, the timestamp      when the operation has occurred gets recorded into `lastRatioUpdate`.This timestamp is then used to check if seconds/update `secondsPerUpdate`      has passed when decreasing yield reward by 3%.

poolExists.details: Keeps track of registered pool addresses, maps pool address -> exists flag.

pools.details: Maps pool token address (like ILV) -> pool address (like core pool instance).

secondsPerUpdate.details: ILV/second decreases by 3% every seconds/update      an update is triggered by executing `updateILVPerSecond` public function.

totalWeight.details: The yield is distributed proportionally to pool weights;      total weight is here to help in determining the proportion.

InvalidState(bytes4,uint256).notice: Thrown on invalid state in a function specified.

ZeroInput(bytes4,uint8).notice: Thrown on zero input at index specified in a function specified.

getPoolAddress(address).notice: Given a pool token retrieves corresponding pool address.

getPoolData(address).notice: Reads pool information for the pool defined by its pool token address,      designed to simplify integration with the front ends.

updateILVPerSecond().notice: Decreases ILV/second reward by 3%, can be executed      no more than once per `secondsPerUpdate` seconds.

userdoc.notice: The contract uses Ownable implementation, so only the eDAO is able to handle         admin activities, such as registering new pools, doing contract upgrades,         changing pool weights, managing emission schedules and so on.
